values.note: Required for the Covered Bridge Festival; otherwise call ahead or just stop in (self-registration envelope when the office is closed).

booking.source: Operator's page as archived 2022-10-06 by the Wayback Machine (secondary: the live page now 404s): http://web.archive.org/web/20221006031836/http://coveredbridgecampground.com/campinginfo.html

facilities.source: Operator's page as archived 2022-10-06 ('We also have showers and restroom facilities'; the live page now 404s): http://web.archive.org/web/20221006031836/http://coveredbridgecampground.com/campinginfo.html

note: Private, closest campground to downtown Rockville. White-rock and grass sites, some shaded; popular for the Covered Bridge Festival. --Claude
summary: No current rate: the live site is a one-page welcome (W/E/S hookups, phone via Google) and its rates page is gone; the last archived rates are 2021, so fees stay empty. 40-ft max rig cleared as unsourced; booking and showers added from the archive; note cleaned.
flags: GATE: presence OK (live website, phone 765-569-5080; Google 3.9/61). Price: no posted current rate. Only RV Life $$ (avg $32) carries it, which suffices for an ordinary private park. No gateway within 40 km, not over the gate on anything I read.

RATE: the operator's rates page 404s. The last archived copy says 'Rates for 2021: Tent camping $25.00, Water & Electric $32.00, Full hookup $35.00' plus 7% tax; older than the 2024 floor, so not written. Nothing I read shows festival-only pricing.

GOOGLE 3.9/61, recent reviews read: 'If it had been full, I would not have enjoyed the small sites... Squeezing a vehicle into the front of one site would be a challenge.' / 'our spot was very close to the one next to us. The shower house stalls didn't have any locks on the doors.' / 'Park need a mow and abit of clean up.' / 'it's peaceful, clean, beautiful area.' / 'If you are looking for a convenient and inexpensive location with full hookups, this is a good spot.' Mixed, no sign of the very poor pattern; your call.
SEASONALS: one review mentions 'seasonal campers'; no share is published. Monthly rates were on the archived page. Not long-stay in character on what I read; no count, so test 4 passes.
SEASON (not written): the 2021-era archive says 'We are open all year. Shower house is open from April through October.' Too old to record without a current statement.
HOOKUPS: 50A rests on the archive ('some 30 & some 50 amp'); W/E/S is on the live page. Left in place. Pin is at the office beside the sites, fine.
